record.name: Laos
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. The Ministry of Technology and Communications leads a draft National AI Strategy; the government agreed in principle in September 2026 to adopt a 2026-2035 AI strategy; final approval not reported.

related_bodies.role: It leads the draft National AI Strategy and the UNESCO AI readiness assessment.

check.language_note: The recorded lo query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Indexed results were sparse or noisy; the recorded language search does not establish complete coverage. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: The ISEAS multi-country strategy sentence supplies general policy context, not substantive Lao institute-status evidence. Confidence was low under that rule; none_identified is a bounded search finding, not proof of absence.
check.governance_note: The state news agency's ministry-event account identifies the ministry-led national AI-strategy and UNESCO readiness process; later adoption remains unverified.

record.notes: The September 2026 decision rests on press coverage (secondary); the primary source is the state news agency report of January 2026 on the UNESCO readiness assessment. Lao-language and English searches.
